stem: A 20 year-old female was involved in a road traffic trauma and was rushed to the casualty because of massive external bleeding. Her estimated weight was 40 kg. stem: A 55-year-old man with a history of hypertension, diabetes and atherosclerosis started experiencing intermittent claudication. An angiogram shows a right common iliac artery stenosis of 90% over a short segment. What is the treatment of choice?

stem: A 29-year old woman comes to the physician for evaluation of a mass in the left breast noticed 2 weeks ago. During this period the mass has not increased in size and has no pain. stem: A 46-year-old woman with a history of relapsing and remitting multiple sclerosis comes to the clinic for review.
